scope: Original common-commander HD assets; lightweight checks; old battle untouched

artReview.method: All ten installed PNGs individually decoded and visually inspected with tools.view_image; bytes pinned again after viewing

assets.name: 夏侯惇
assets.reviewMethod: Direct tools.view_image at original detail of actual installed PNG
assets.notes: 夏侯惇：蓝色羽缨、铁盔和须发轮廓完整；深色披巾与严峻面容可辨。

assets.name: 夏侯渊
assets.reviewMethod: Direct tools.view_image at original detail of actual installed PNG
assets.notes: 夏侯渊：低盔、宽脸和浓须完整，与夏侯惇羽盔和脸型有区别；左侧旗面为失焦抽象纹样，未读出文字。

assets.name: 张郃
assets.reviewMethod: Direct tools.view_image at original detail of actual installed PNG
assets.notes: 张郃：酒红羽饰极靠近上沿，但上沿主体区域仍有背景，未见羽饰轮廓被直接截断；不据此声称宽松留白或15%量化。

assets.name: 甘宁
assets.reviewMethod: Direct tools.view_image at original detail of actual installed PNG
assets.notes: 甘宁：包头巾及垂布完整，较年轻窄脸、短须和土黄色内层可辨；背景未见可读字。

assets.name: 太史慈
assets.reviewMethod: Direct tools.view_image at original detail of actual installed PNG
assets.notes: 太史慈：红羽盔、短须和披巾完整，脸型与张郃不同；背景红旗为模糊纹样，未读出文字。

assets.name: 徐晃
assets.reviewMethod: Direct tools.view_image at original detail of actual installed PNG
assets.notes: 徐晃P1：灰包头巾与长垂布完整，灰披巾、面容和须发可辨。

assets.name: 徐晃
assets.reviewMethod: Direct tools.view_image at original detail of actual installed PNG
assets.notes: 徐晃P2：独立圆盔与布结完整，保留不同期头饰和构图，未复制P1成品。

assets.name: 程普
assets.reviewMethod: Direct tools.view_image at original detail of actual installed PNG
assets.notes: 程普：布帽、灰须发完整，较成熟脸部与橄榄色披巾可辨；旗面纹样失焦不可读。

assets.name: 黄盖
assets.reviewMethod: Direct tools.view_image at original detail of actual installed PNG
assets.notes: 黄盖：圆沿军帽、白眉白须完整，老将面容与其它人物区别明显。

assets.name: 周泰
assets.reviewMethod: Direct tools.view_image at original detail of actual installed PNG
assets.notes: 周泰：旧布盔及垂布完整，暗色护甲和较粗犷的须发面容可辨；左侧旗为模糊纹样，未见可读文字。

zhangHeBoundaryObservation.method: Original-resolution direct image inspection, supplemented by read-only PIL RGB samples in subject top region x=600..850
zhangHeBoundaryObservation.conclusion: Plume is very close to upper boundary but no visibly severed contour; subject top-boundary region retains background. Pixel samples are supplementary, not semantic segmentation or a 15 percent clearance measurement.

artReview.backgroundBanners: Several flags contain soft abstract emblem-like patterns. No readable words, name labels or watermark were visible.
